description: Unit test class for EmployeeMembershipDao, testing CRUD operations and search functionality within the EmployeeMembershipDao class in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to verify functionalities of EmployeeMembershipDao, including retrieval, deletion, searching, saving, and editing employee memberships.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixture by creating an instance of EmployeeMembershipDao and populating test data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee membership by ID and validates retrieved data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple employee memberships and asserts correct deletion count.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests search functionality for employee memberships with specific filter params.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembershipWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with limit parameter and verifies the number of results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests creating and saving a new EmployeeMembership entity.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests editing an existing EmployeeMembership entity and saving changes.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of employee memberships matching a filter.
